bug_semantics: SpreadsheetML Reader\Xml casts an attacker-controlled <Row ss:Index> to $rowID with no upper bound against AddressRange::MAX_ROW (1,048,576). That $rowID is then passed to Worksheet::getRowDimension() (Hidden/Height) and/or concatenated into $cellRange for getCell(); both raise cachedHighestRow. RowIterator defaults its end to getHighestRow(), so a ~300-byte XML file with ss:Index="999999999" forces ~1e9 loop iterations and CPU DoS.
flaw_origin: The unbounded ss:Index assignment (rowID = (integer) $row_ss['Index'] with no Excel row-limit check) was first written in the 2010 git-svn import of PHPExcel's Excel2003XML reader, later renamed to Reader/Xml.php. The same root snapshot already wired that $rowID into getRowDimension() (Height) and cell addressing, and RowIterator::valid() already compared position to getHighestRow(). Later work only renamed/refactored the file, added a Hidden sink in 2023, and finally added the MAX_ROW continue in 2026; none of those later commits first wrote the missing bound.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: GHSA-84wq-86v6-x5j6 / CVE-2026-40863 is a live CWE-770 CPU DoS, not withdrawn. Reader\Xml trusts SpreadsheetML ss:Index on <Row>, casts it to int, and uses it as a worksheet row number. Worksheet::getRowDimension and getCell both bump cachedHighestRow; RowIterator then walks 1..getHighestRow(). A crafted Index of 999999999 therefore turns a tiny XML file into ~1 billion iterator steps. The PoC uses Hidden to hit getRowDimension without cells, but any Cell in that row also builds $cellRange from the inflated $rowID, matching the advisory. The 2026 patch skips rows outside [1, MAX_ROW] and the x5j6 fixture proves highest row stays 3. BIC search used git log -L on the Index block, not an AI-marked commit hunt. The first write of the unbounded assignment is root commit 509f27e5c601c002090af18a5dd545b06b7183ca (Excel2003XML.php lines 522-524), whose parent does not exist (git rev-list --parents / rev-parse ^). That snapshot also already contains cachedHighestRow inflation and RowIterator::valid() vs getHighestRow(), so the mechanism is complete at first public write. 509f27e5 is a git-svn snapshot of CodePlex r59884, not a later squash of git members; no finer public member of these lines is reconstructable in the assigned clone, so the root first-write is the BIC rather than a later Hidden refactor. 482fe6de only added an extra Hidden sink in 2023; 6da04eb1 had previously removed Height handling but left the cell sink. File renames and (integer)→(int) casts are not BICs. The Index lines are present in affected 5.6.0 / 1.30.3 and absent-of-bound until 9019a9c9, which is an ancestor of 5.7.0 and not of 5.6.0, matching the advisory ranges; branch Security Patches commits carry the same continue. AI is judged only on 509f27e5: human author/committer Maarten Balliauw in 2010, git-svn trailer only, no commit-object AI marker. Therefore NOT_AI.
